commands.full: cargo bench -p jx --bench throughput --locked (same command as just bench), sequentially: inline-full.csv, tree-full.csv, final-full.csv
commands.differential: node scripts/check-SUITE.cjs target/m11/jsonata target/release/jx for sequences, scalars, filters, aggregates, constructors, lexical, navigation, compiler, execution
commands.initial_execution: JX_BENCH_FILTER=execution cargo bench -p jx --bench throughput --locked. Run order: tree-execution-first, inline-execution-first, no-sharing-first, tree-execution-repeat, inline-execution-repeat, no-sharing-repeat.
commands.variants: Apply inline-plan.patch to final source for the inlined prototype; additionally apply repeated-loads.patch for no-sharing. Apply consuming-atomic.patch to the M10 baseline for the discarded ownership experiment. Apply preserved-tags.patch to final source for the discarded enum-order control.
commands.atomic: JX_BENCH_FILTER=escaped_strings (or wide_group) JX_BENCH_SAMPLE_MS=250 cargo bench -p jx --bench throughput --locked. Run order: tree-strings, atomic-strings, tree-group, atomic-group, atomic-strings-repeat, tree-strings-repeat, atomic-group-repeat, tree-group-repeat.
commands.tags: JX_BENCH_FILTER=ascii/ JX_BENCH_BYTES=100 JX_BENCH_SAMPLE_MS=150 cargo bench -p jx --bench throughput --locked; tags-ascii-first, tree-ascii-repeat, tags-ascii-repeat. Then wide_last and scalar/sequence_ without byte restriction at 150 ms for tags then tree. tags-execution uses execution and the default 50 ms.
commands.final_repeats: JX_BENCH_FILTER=execution and compiler/ at 50 ms; ascii/ with JX_BENCH_BYTES=100 and 500, wide_last and scalar/sequence_ at 150 ms; wide_group and escaped_strings at 250 ms. Files named final-*.csv.
commands.profile: Run the built throughput binary with JX_BENCH_FILTER=scalar/escaped_strings (26 B), navigation/wide_group (600386 B), or execution/filtered_sum (8586 B), JX_BENCH_BYTES selecting that size and JX_BENCH_SAMPLE_MS=1000. After its first sample, sample PID 3 1 -file report.txt. Profile timings are instrumented and excluded from comparison tables.

notes: tree-initial-partial.csv contains all 560 original workloads plus an incomplete new execution group. Its new filtered-sum fixture stopped on an untimed expected JSON number mismatch (22 versus 22.0); the expectation was corrected. The main comparison uses the later complete tree-full.csv.
Source manifests describe the final benchmark expectations. Unit/integration tests were expanded after early prototype measurements; release engine behavior was unchanged by those additions.

The final runtime differs from inline-full only by keeping Plan::run out of line. This restores the tree frame from 1408 to 960 bytes including saved registers on this compiler; registers occupy their own invocation frame.
Consuming atomic conversion and preserving enum tags were not integrated. Patches are reproduction evidence only.
Timing is single-threaded, with no benchmark processes or builds run concurrently. Files with profile prefixes are excluded from timing comparisons.
No new language semantics or conformance classifications; 568 pinned cases and 31200 differential comparisons pass.
